summary: Verified 036 domain, authorization, refusal, budget, and effect records own their facts; GraphARC trace, policy audit, session rows, checkpoints, cost, replay, and OTel are partial or derived surfaces.
GraphExecutionEventV1 is a registered 036 domain-event family with sealed graph and explicit causal/reference identity, not a graph-local ledger or telemetry wrapper.
Trusted replay folds domain sequence only after multi-ledger reference closure and exact registry, upcaster, reducer, canonicalizer, checkpoint, and artifact verification.
OTel is a versioned redacted projection with stable IDs and recovery receipts; ambiguity, duplication, lag, sampling, or outage cannot affect graph authority.
Projection disagreement is preserved at the earliest mismatch; derived surfaces rebuild, canonical cut failures block publication, and history is never rewritten.
Shadow parity compares required per-operation causal prefixes over sealed inputs and closed observations so terminal equality cannot erase earlier semantic divergence.
Mutants target ordering, inference, omission, duplication, redaction, open references, checkpoint drift, export ambiguity, and false terminal equivalence while effects remain suppressed.
